races.verdict: NAUTIC STAR has been out of the frame just once in her 8 career starts and this looks a good opportunity for Jessica Harrington's filly to get off the mark. Heading up the dangers is Donna Time , who found listed company all too much on just her fourth career start in the summer but can get back on track returning in much calmer waters.
